title: AI for Vision 2040: Machine Learning Algorithms to Strengthen Omani Youth Employment
funder: Institutional grant aligned with Oman Vision 2040
highlights: Upgraded AI laboratory infrastructure to support LLM work and NVIDIA Jetson modules.
Developed machine learning pipelines aimed at employability outcomes for Omani youth.

title: Modernization of IoT and AI Laboratory
highlights: Established AI and IoT research infrastructure including NVIDIA Jetson kits.
Enabled student-led AI applications in healthcare and agriculture.

title: Ancient Asian Character Recognition Using Deep Learning (KAKENHI 18K18337)
highlights: Developed CNN-based OCR models for 4,212 ancient character classes.
Reached 90–92% recognition accuracy across multiple historical scripts.
